privacy.descriPermission: Guardián Escolar requests access to certain device features solely to provide the school monitoring service. Location permission allows the bus's position to be shown in real time on the interactive map and estimated arrival times to be calculated. Camera permission is used exclusively for scanning QR codes that log the student's entry and exit from the vehicle. Notification permission is used to inform you immediately of relevant events during your child's trip. No permission is used for any purpose other than those described here, and you can revoke them at any time from your device settings, understanding that this may limit some app functionality.
privacy.descripDatas: In compliance with the purpose limitation principle established in Colombian Law 1581 of 2012, Guardián Escolar collects only the personal data strictly necessary to provide the monitored school transportation service. This data includes: student identification information (name, assigned route, educational institution), guardian contact details (name, email, phone), and service operational data (bus GPS location, entry and exit times recorded via QR code). No additional sensitive data is collected, nor is this information shared with third parties unrelated to the operation of the school transportation service.
privacy.descripProtection: All communication between the app and our servers is carried out using encryption protocols (HTTPS/TLS), ensuring that students' location, identity, and contact information travels protected end to end. This measure responds to the obligation established in Article 4 of Law 1581 of 2012, which requires data controllers to adopt the technical measures necessary to secure records, preventing their alteration, loss, unauthorized consultation, use, or access.
privacy.descripAutentication: Access to the platform is protected through secure authentication mechanisms. User passwords are stored encrypted and are never saved or transmitted as plain text. As an additional protective measure against unauthorized access attempts, the system temporarily locks an account after several consecutive failed login attempts, notifying this event for follow-up.
privacy.descripAccess: In accordance with the restricted circulation principle established in Law 1581 of 2012, access to information within Guardián Escolar is segmented according to each user's role. A guardian can only view the information and location corresponding to their child; a driver only accesses data for the route assigned to them; and an administrator manages routes and users under an audit log that records every action performed, ensuring traceability and control over the use of information.
privacy.descripRegister: Each student entry or exit event is recorded using a unique QR code, stored with date, time, and exact location, which helps prevent duplicate, fraudulent, or inconsistent records. Once the event is confirmed, the system automatically and immediately notifies the guardian, ensuring transparency and timely information about the student's status during the school trip.
privacy.descripElimination: Location data and trip history are retained for a maximum period of thirty (30) days, the time necessary for traceability, auditing, and handling possible incidents. After this period, the information is securely deleted. In accordance with the right to erasure set out in Law 1581 of 2012, the guardian may request the deletion of their child's personal data at any time, unless there is a legal or regulatory obligation requiring it to be retained.
privacy.descripConnection: Guardián Escolar is designed to operate reliably even in areas with intermittent network coverage. When the bus device temporarily loses signal, location data is securely stored on the device and automatically synced with the server once the connection is restored, ensuring that no trip record is lost or altered during this process.
privacy.descripLaws: In accordance with the Colombian Political Constitution and Law 1581 of 2012 (Personal Data Protection Law), as the data subject — or as the student's legal representative — you have the right to: know, update, and correct your personal information; request proof of the authorization granted for the processing of your data; be informed about how your information has been used; file complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce for violations of the law; revoke authorization and/or request the deletion of your data when constitutional and legal principles, rights, and guarantees are not respected; and access your personal data free of charge. To exercise any of these rights, you can contact the school administrator or our designated support channel.

terms.descriObject: Guardian Escolar es una herramienta de apoyo para el monitoreo del transporte escolar: registro de instituciones, rutas, vehículos, conductores, estudiantes y acudientes; seguimiento del recorrido en tiempo real; confirmación de abordaje y descenso con códigos QR; y notificaciones del servicio. Proyecto formativo del SENA con fines académicos y de demostración; no es un servicio comercial ni garantiza disponibilidad permanente.
terms.descriAcceptance: El registro y el uso continuado implican la lectura, comprensión y aceptación integral de estos Términos y de la Política de Tratamiento de Datos. Quien no esté de acuerdo debe abstenerse de usar la plataforma. La aceptación y la autorización de datos de menores corresponden exclusivamente a sus padres o acudientes legales.
terms.descriRoles: Superadministrador: administración general y seguridad de la información. Administrador: registra y mantiene institución, rutas, vehículos, conductores, estudiantes y acudientes. Conductor: opera el vehículo según la ruta, usa el módulo QR y mantiene la ubicación activa; conserva su responsabilidad legal del transporte. Acudiente: mantiene actualizados sus datos y los del estudiante, y reporta novedades.
terms.descriProperUse: Usar la plataforma solo para sus fines: no suministrar información falsa, no compartir credenciales ni el QR, no vulnerar su seguridad, no usar datos con otros fines. El incumplimiento puede suspender o cancelar la cuenta.
terms.descriLocation: La ubicación del vehículo solo está disponible durante recorridos autorizados y activos, y solo para los acudientes de la ruta y administradores autorizados, con fines exclusivos de monitoreo. No se garantiza exactitud absoluta ni disponibilidad ininterrumpida del GPS.
terms.descriQr: Cada estudiante tiene un QR personal e intransferible para registrar abordaje y descenso. No puede compartirse ni prestarse; su uso indebido puede suspender la funcionalidad. Pérdida o mal funcionamiento se reporta al administrador.
terms.descriLiability: Herramienta de apoyo al monitoreo; no sustituye obligaciones legales de instituciones, transportadoras ni conductores, ni garantiza prevenir accidentes. Proyecto formativo sin garantía de disponibilidad permanente o ininterrumpida.
terms.descriAccounts: Ante información falsa, uso indebido, incumplimiento o solicitud del titular o la institución, el acceso puede suspenderse o cancelarse, comunicándolo por los medios registrados.
terms.descriContact: Consultas, derechos de datos (conocer, actualizar, rectificar, suprimir, revocar) y reportes por los canales de la plataforma o con el administrador del colegio.

aboutus.descripAbout:
We are a team of three SENA students developing technology solutions focused on improving real processes. This app is part of our training project, in which we apply the knowledge acquired in software analysis and development to create a functional, secure, and easy-to-use system.

 Our work is aimed at strengthening school transportation management, providing tools that improve communication, organization, and peace of mind for students, parents, and guardians.
aboutus.descripMission: To develop a reliable application for managing and tracking school routes, enabling real-time monitoring of student transportation and improving safety and communication between families and educational institutions.
aboutus.descripVision: To be a leading technology project in school transportation solutions, standing out for innovation, ease of use, and commitment to safety, with the goal of growing and adapting to new needs in the future.
aboutus.descripTeam: Guardián Escolar was born from the joint work of Johan Smith Santamaria Fernández, Sharik Dayanna Rojas Ibarra, and Juan Pablo Chala Ramírez, trainees of the SENA Software Analysis and Development program, under the guidance of instructors assigned by SENA. Each team member contributed their role in the analysis, design, development, and database management of the project.
aboutus.descripValues: Security, transparency, and commitment are the principles that guide every decision behind Guardián Escolar. We believe technology should serve students' wellbeing, giving families the peace of mind of knowing their children are safe on every school trip.
